commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Barcelona get a corner.
90+6' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+5' 2 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Savio plays it into the box, and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:4.

90+3' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.

90+2' 2 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Ferran Torres, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), who beats Paulo Gazzaniga with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:3.
90+1' Cristhian Stuani slides a brilliant pass into Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A rebound spins to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just over the bar.
87' Here's the change. Ivan Martin leaves the pitch and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
87' Lamine Yamal swings the cross over. Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
84' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

83' What a wasted opportunity by Savio (Girona)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Inaki Pena makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
83' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
80' 1 - 3 Gooal! Valery (Girona) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Cristhian Stuani. He makes it 1:3.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is replacing Pedri.
78' Here comes a substitution. Yan Couto is given a rest as he is replaced by Valery (Girona).
78' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Portu (Girona) replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
76' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga easily deals with the threat.
74' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Barcelona win a free kick.
73' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Artem Dovbyk walks off.
70' The attendance for today's match is 42848.
68' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the right post.
68' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
67' Yan Couto (Girona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
65' Here is a change. Raphinha is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
65' Xavi prepares a substitution. Joao Felix is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
65' Substitution. Andreas Christensen did his best and is replaced by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
65' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
64' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
64' Daley Blind (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

64' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
62' Savio (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is first to react to a great cross from Savio, but slices his shot well wide of the left post from inside the box.
58' Raphinha (Barcelona) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Paulo Gazzaniga keeps it out.

57' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
56' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
55' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. Savio (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play. Barcelona have a free kick.
54' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
53' A poorly executed free kick by Raphinha (Barcelona). His shot from the edge of the box sails way wide of the left post.

52' Eric Garcia (Girona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for an infringement. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
51' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Paulo Gazzaniga stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
50' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Girona earn a free kick.

47' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera saw the whole situation. Girona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.

45+3' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45+2' Isidro Diaz de Mera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Savio (Girona) and blew his whistle. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

40' 1 - 2 Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) scores with a great individual effort! He makes a good run, skips past defenders and fires the ball from the edge of the box past the diving goalkeeper. The shot went inside the left post. Absolutely phenomenal!
40' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is free in the box and Savio finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!

39' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Paulo Gazzaniga!
38' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

38' Raphinha (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
37' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

36' Raphinha (Barcelona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
35' Savio (Girona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
34' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

32' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the left side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Paulo Gazzaniga.
30' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
28' Yan Couto (Girona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.

28' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Inaki Pena anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Girona earn a corner.
24' Savio picks out Artem Dovbyk (Girona) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
22' Raphinha (Barcelona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

19' 1 - 1 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Raphinha. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
19' Corner kick. Raphinha (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
19' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
17' One of the players from Girona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Isidro Diaz de Mera signals. There is a free kick near the sideline to Girona.
16' Raphinha (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
15' Joao Felix (Barcelona) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
15' Joao Felix (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga comes off the line to clear the ball away.

12' 0 - 1 Viktor Tsygankov is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the right post to make the score 0:1.
10' Joao Felix (Barcelona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga is quickest to intercept the ball.
7' A pass from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is intercepted by Paulo Gazzaniga and the move breaks down.
6' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
6' Joao Felix (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
4' Joao Felix (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), but Paulo Gazzaniga is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
3' The rebound finds David Lopez (Girona) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
2' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the corner.
2' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
